create_inhouse_requester: create a new InhouseRequester instance using the static new method with a MephistoDB and requester name
register_inhouse_requester: register an InhouseRequester with optional InhouseRequesterArgs to log the registration in the Mephisto DB
check_inhouse_registered: check if an InhouseRequester is registered by calling is_registered which returns a boolean
get_inhouse_budget: get the available budget for an InhouseRequester by calling get_available_budget which returns a float
review_inhouse_requester_class: review the InhouseRequester class and its methods for extending crowd provider requester functionality
